lines.text: Jesus traveled in Galilee, avoiding Judea where the Jews sought to kill Him, and the Feast of Tabernacles neared.
His brothers told Him to go to Judea so His disciples could see His works, but they did not believe.
Jesus said the world hates Him because He testifies its works are evil, and told them to go up alone.
Jesus stayed in Galilee, but after His brothers went up to the feast, He also went openly.
At the feast the Jews looked for Him, and some called Him good while others said He breaks the Sabbath.
